title: Magistra Predictor: A Dual-Track Framework for GLP-1 Side Effect Estimation
description:
Methodology code, model configuration and preprint behind Magistra (magistra.health), an open, continuously updated system that estimates GLP-1 medication side-effect rates by reporting two parallel signals per effect: a clinical incidence estimate pooled from clinical-trial registry results, papers and regulatory reports, and a community reporting frequency. The two are displayed side by side and never blended or treated as comparable quantities.

Contents: read-only dated snapshots of the live estimation code (random-effects pooling with a between-study heterogeneity term, rate-eligibility rules, FDR-corrected empirical modifier estimation), the live model configuration, the full methodology preprint with its correction log, API examples, and the per-effect aggregate pooled-rates table (data/glp1-aggregate-rates.csv and .json).

Licences: code under Apache-2.0. The aggregate table in data/ is separately licensed CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Magistra, magistra.health). Magistra's underlying point-level corpus is not included in this archive and is not covered by either licence. The canonical, continuously updated methodology is at https://magistra.health/en/methodology; this archive is a dated snapshot of the repository at the tagged release.

Data, not medical advice.
